svg.title: What a $400 car repair costs beyond the $400, four ways
svg.desc: A $400 car repair with $100 in checking. Overdrawing the debit card, with four overdraft fees: $140. A payday loan for the $300 you're short, kept eight weeks: $180 in fees. A credit card at 22%, paying $50 a month: about $37 in interest. Your own savings: $0. Fees and rates are illustrative; some banks charge less for an overdraft, or nothing.
